purpose: > **@deprecated since 6.0 — use `DocCallToAction` (`@aziontech/webkit/doc-call-to-action`) instead. Removed in 7.0.** `DocCta` keeps working: it renders `DocCallToAction`, mapping `primaryLabel` / `primaryHref` to `primaryAction` and `secondaryLabel` / `secondaryHref` to `secondaryAction`, and keeps its own `documentation-doc-cta` test id. The closing offer of a documentation page, parked at the foot of the "On this page" rail after the outline. It is a docs card built like every other card on the page: a `FrameBox` with corner marks, a flat `--bg-surface` face, the wordmark at the headline size, a headline, a subtitle and full-width stacked actions. Set on the rail scale (14 px headline, 12 px copy) so it never out-shouts the page outline. Every string is content passed by the page.
useWhen: Existing pages only, until they move to `DocCallToAction`.
avoidWhen: In the prose column — use `CallToAction` on marketing pages or a `DocCard` link in docs.
related: DocCallToAction` — the replacement, which this component renders.
bestPractices: One primary action; a secondary only when it is a real alternative (talk to sales).
A one-line headline and a one-line subtitle.
